orbits.name: Passion Projects
orbits.blurb: Closest to the core. Built because I wanted them to exist.

projects.title: Sovrin Console
projects.tagline: Every agent, every machine, one interface.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: A desktop app that unifies every AI agent running across every machine into a single interface. Replaces the earlier Textual-TUI version (Sovrin Terminal) while keeping the same backend.

sections.heading: How it is built
sections.body: PySide6/Qt front end over a Hermes gateway bridge speaking JSON-RPC. SQLite with FTS5 for full-text search. UDP multicast for LAN discovery, plus a WireGuard relay for reaching machines across networks.

orbits.name: Digital Products
orbits.blurb: Tools and infrastructure. Built, running, proven.

projects.title: Gol
projects.tagline: Arrives on a flash drive. Leaves no trace.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: A portable, no-install field diagnostic and security scanner. Runs straight from a flash drive, performs a full OS scan and produces a report, and leaves nothing behind on the target machine.

sections.heading: Why it exists
sections.body: On-site diagnostics usually mean installing software on someone else's computer. This does not.

projects.title: Golam
projects.tagline: The WARD suite. Gol, with teeth.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: Wraps Gol's scanner with ClamAV for real malware detection, packaged as a tray-icon desktop application.

sections.heading: How it is built
sections.body: pywebview for the interface, pystray for the tray presence, bundled ClamAV binaries for detection.

projects.title: Self-Hosted Storage
projects.tagline: The cloud, if the cloud were mine.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: A Nextcloud instance running on my own hardware, reachable over WireGuard. No third-party cloud storage anywhere in the loop.

sections.heading: How it is built
sections.body: Docker Compose stack: Nextcloud, MariaDB, and Caddy as the reverse proxy.

projects.title: VPN Relay
projects.tagline: A door only I know the shape of.

sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: A small cloud droplet acting as a WireGuard rendezvous point, so my laptop can reach home machines from anywhere without exposing them directly to the internet.

projects.title: SOVRIN First Build
projects.tagline: Where the look of this map started.

sections.heading: What it is
